units.source_text: “可是，你却让我在显微镜下看到了受精卵，我确实感到那色彩图案很美。

en.t: But you showed me a fertilized egg under the microscope, and I truly felt that its colors and patterns were beautiful.

units.source_text: 看到受精卵逐渐变化的过程，简直是神灵的图案啊！

en.t: Watching the fertilized egg gradually change was simply like seeing a pattern made by the gods!

units.source_text: 对了，记得有一回，小宠犬肚子里闹蛔虫，你告诉我那种令人恶心的蛔虫，也拥有那样美丽的细胞。

en.t: Oh yes, I remember once when my little pet dog had roundworms in its belly, you told me that even those disgusting roundworms had such beautiful cells.

units.source_text: 我仅仅聆听这点指教，都感到很幸福。”

en.t: Just hearing that from you made me feel very happy.
